## Remarks

Issues a `DELETE`<!-- -->, not a `TRUNCATE`<!-- -->: sqlite has no `TRUNCATE`<!-- -->, and on the other dialects `TRUNCATE` trips over foreign keys pointing at the table. As a result auto-increment counters are \*not\* reset.
